C1195.title: Luzhou Cyber Police Crack Down on SMS Bombing Software and Service Providers
C1195.summary: In 2024, while handling a relationship dispute case, Luzhou public security authorities faced retaliation when a suspect used an SMS bombing tool to harass the investigating officers. The Luzhou cyber police traced the attack and found that the suspect, surnamed Wang, had purchased a "call-you-to-death" service online, using automated tools provided by a group led by a suspect surnamed Xie to send large volumes of messages to specified numbers.

references.title: Rampant 'call-you-to-death' harassment? Cyber police pursue across provinces and reveal the hidden chain
